patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, size, color, variant.
<Badge> size must be one of 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'.
<Badge> color must be one of 'grey' | 'blue' | 'red' | 'green' | 'teal' | 'yellow'.
<Badge> variant must be one of 'weak' | 'fill'.
<BottomSheet> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open, title, children, onClose.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, variant, color, size, fullWidth, loading, disabled, leftIcon, rightIcon.
<Button> variant must be one of 'fill' | 'weak' | 'outline'.
<Button> color must be one of 'brand' | 'neutral' | 'danger' | 'dark'.
<Button> size must be one of 'large' | 'medium' | 'small' | 'tiny'.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, padding, radius, shadow.
<Checkbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, onChange, shape, size, disabled, label, style.
<Checkbox> shape must be one of 'square' | 'circle'.
<Chip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, selected, size, leadingIcon, trailingIcon.
<Chip> size must be one of 'small' | 'medium'.
<Dialog> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open, title, children, primaryLabel, onPrimary, secondaryLabel, onSecondary, onClose.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size, color.
<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, size, variant.
<IconButton> size must be one of 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'.
<IconButton> variant must be one of 'ghost' | 'weak' | 'fill'.
<ListRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, description, left, right, arrow, bold, onClick.
<Loader> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, color, stroke, style.
<ProgressBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, max, height, color, style.
<SearchField> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, onChange, placeholder, onClear.
<SegmentedControl> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: options, value, onChange, style.
<Stepper> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, onChange, min, max, step, disabled, style.
<Switch> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, onChange, disabled, style.
<TabBarItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: key, label, icon.
<Tabs> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, value, onChange, fluid, style.
<TextButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, size, color, underline, arrow.
<TextButton> size must be one of 'large' | 'medium' | 'small'.
<TextButton> color must be one of 'brand' | 'neutral' | 'strong' | 'danger'.
<TextField> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, value, onChange, placeholder, variant, error, suffix, disabled.

<Toast> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, icon, action, style.
